capabilities: Builds ticked notes into a read-only site as a zip archive or folder
Filters notes by path and property rules with regular expressions
Renders notes with Obsidian reading view, graph, backlinks, outline and search
Reviews what goes in and what stays out before building
Runs headless builds on a server through obsidian-cmd-runner
extras: Warns that copied Obsidian, theme and plugin stylesheets belong to their authors, so think before sharing a site publicly; output must be kept out of sync (gitignore); zip limited to 4 GB and 65,535 files; canvases and bases are excluded; builds are byte-for-byte deterministic.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn a chosen subset of a vault into a self-contained read-only website that opens from a file with no server or network.

relations.evidence: obsidian-cmd-runner starts Obsidian without its window, on a build server after a push or from a script

summary: Static-site exporter that builds chosen notes into a read-only website drawn by Obsidian, packed as one zip with index.html.
